outcome: Time required for heart rate (HR) detection
cohort: The study included 41 infants from high-risk delivery cases, 11 of whom required resuscitation, with varying gestational ages.
finding: Time from ECG placement to HR detection was significantly faster than from PO placement, especially in infants with gestational age less than 32 weeks.
gest_age: Less than 32 weeks, 32-35 weeks, and greater than or equal to 36 weeks
